ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) dominance in central and lower regions, with 25% high-intensity (white/light grey) regions localized at the distal tips and lateral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patch at the far left tip extending inward along the trailing edge; fragmented white/grey mottling at the far right tip; solid dark pigmentation across the median and basal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 135 degrees and a moderate depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; left lobe contains several medium-amplitude jagged peaks; right lobe displays finer, low-amplitude rhythmic serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curve fitted to the upper boundary of both lobes, sweeping upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of roughly circular high-contrast white spots visible on the dark pigmentation of the inner-left lobe; smaller clusters present along the inferior margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct diagonal dark linear disruptions on the upper-right lobe; one horizontal white scratch near the distal-left tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep, irregular indentation/notch on the outer margin of the left lobe tip, distinct from standard serration; vertical scarring on the surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown discoloration patch visible on the high-intensity region of the inner-left fluke lobe.
